rating.verdict: A fun Star Trek theme deck. In Modern it's well behind real aggro decks like Boros Energy, so treat it as a casual deck.
strengths: Burn gives reach to close games
Officer synergies reward a wide board
weaknesses: Card quality is low for Modern
Sweepers and cheap removal blunt it

wins: Burn and phasers hold the line early, then a wide crew of Starfleet officers reaches 8 total power and counterattacks with stacked attack triggers.
plan: Use burn on their early creatures (Planetary Bombardment, Transporter Malfunction) while deploying Tactical Officer, Munitions Enthusiast and Worf.
Captain Jean-Luc Picard (anthem and Officer tokens) and Cantankerous Captain. Kira Nerys makes later creatures enter attacking.
At 8+ total power every attack triggers Tactical Officer, Worf and La’An (a creature can’t block). Khan clears small blockers and pings everyone; Odo stuns the best blocker.
keys: +1/+1 to your team and an Officer per creature you cast: the fastest route to 8 power.
While you’re attacking, creatures you cast enter tapped and attacking with +1/+1. Flash-in tricks become extra attackers.
2 damage for 1 mana, or 4 if a creature died this turn: cast it after combat trades.
Instant 3 damage to any target, and you can discard a dead card to draw a new one.
tips: Count power before combat: 8 is the magic number for most of your triggers.
Munitions Enthusiast deals 1 when it dies, which also turns on the 4-damage Bombardment.
Test of Conviction: +1/+1 counters on everything to reach 8, or draw two when you’re behind.
Transporter Malfunction can be cast again late with Beam me up.
Quark’s Bar enters untapped once you control two other lands: ping each opponent or surveil.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 lands with an early creature and a burn spell.
